---
title: "Solar Detection & Income"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
```

### Read in the data

```{r}
oahu_solar <- st_read(here("data/oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))

View(oahu_solar)
```

### Map the data

```{r}
mapview(oahu_solar)
```

Just for fun:

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_solar) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal() 
```

### Retrieve some census data

```{r}
oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract", 
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  geometry = TRUE,
  year = 2022)
```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income,
        zcol = "moe")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_median_household_income, 
       aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
